tool_fix.reason: Genuine bug blocked the seal: 9d3454f applied live-digest equality to SUPERSEDED history, making --verify-chain unsatisfiable for any evolving chain; and --write never superseded older records, so no --write could ever pass --verify-chain.
tool_fix.fix: verify(): live-equality (sig_status, policy_digest, gate_impl_digest, control_set_sha, gate_sha) applies only to the newest non-superseded record; SUPERSEDED records keep record_hash/prev_hash integrity + recursion into the newest (tamper-evidence preserved via content addressing, currency anchored at newest). --write: supersedes all older records (star topology onto newest, prev_hash relinked forward, each re-sealed; fails closed on a broken prev_hash chain), then links the new record to the rewritten predecessor — mirroring the proven reseal_next.py cascade. gate_impl_digest unchanged (gate_control.py is not a sealed body).
